name: SITE123
description_en:
SITE123 is a hosted website builder organized around ready-made layouts and content editing. Users choose a website type, add their material, preview it and publish through the online service. A free platform subdomain is available indefinitely, while custom domains, branding removal, larger quotas and store/email capabilities depend on paid packages.

The main trade-off is a guided hosted workflow with limited portability. SITE123 explicitly says websites cannot be downloaded. Assess the editor and a representative form or store flow before upgrading, and compare the exact package term: the homepage and pricing FAQ currently show different starting custom-domain prices.
description_zh:
SITE123 是围绕预设布局和内容编辑组织的托管建站工具。用户选择网站类型、添加素材、预览后通过在线服务发布。平台子域名可持续免费使用；自定义域名、移除品牌、更大配额及商店/邮件能力取决于付费套餐。

主要取舍是引导式托管流程与有限可迁移性。SITE123 明确称不能下载网站。升级前应评估编辑器和代表性表单或商店流程，并比较具体套餐期限：当前首页与定价 FAQ 的自定义域名起价不同。

core_features.name_zh: 以内容为主的托管编辑
core_features.explanation_en: Choose a website type and replace content within provided styles/layouts; hosting is included rather than a separate server installation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选择网站类型，在提供的样式/布局中替换内容，包含托管，无需另装服务器。

core_features.explanation_en: Desktop/mobile/new-window preview precedes Publish; saved editor changes do not automatically become public.
core_features.explanation_zh: 发布前可用桌面/手机/新窗口预览，保存编辑器更改不会自动公开。

core_features.name_zh: 有容量上限的免费子域名
core_features.explanation_en: Free lists 250 MB storage/bandwidth; the displayed Premium card lists 3 GB each, domain connection and branding removal.
core_features.explanation_zh: Free 列出存储/带宽各 250 MB，所显示 Premium 卡片为各 3 GB，并含连接域名和移除品牌。

pricing.summary_en: Free indefinitely on subdomain with 250MB quotas. Homepage $12.80 versus pricing FAQ $10.80 annual monthly starting claims conflict; package card numeric quote absent. Longer prepaid terms, domain/email and separate AI renewal require checkout review.
pricing.summary_zh: 子域名持续免费，配额各 250MB；首页 $12.80 与定价 FAQ $10.80 的年付月均起价冲突，套餐卡未显示金额，长期预付、域名/邮件及独立 AI 续费需结账核对。

sections.title_en: Build and inspect before buying a domain plan
sections.title_zh: 购买域名方案前先构建检查
sections.en: Start without a card on the Free website, choose the relevant site type, replace sample content and add a real contact action. In the preview controls, review desktop, tablet/mobile and New Window so you can test links/buttons outside the editor. Mobile-specific header, font, menu and spacing settings can address layout problems without changing desktop settings. The App preview/settings described in the guide are not evidence of a separately commissioned native app or App Store approval. For a store, validate catalog, payment provider, notifications and fulfillment separately rather than assuming the website preview proves transactions work.
sections.zh: 可免卡从 Free 网站开始，选择类型、替换样例并增加真实联系行动。预览中检查桌面、平板/手机及 New Window，在编辑器外测试链接/按钮。手机专用头部、字体、菜单和间距可修复布局而不改变桌面设置。指南中的 App 预览/设置不证明获得独立原生应用或商店审核。商店还需分别验证目录、支付商、通知和履约，不能用网站预览证明交易可用。

sections.en: The guide says click Publish in the editor, confirm Yes and verify the live URL after success. Republish after every intended public change. It warns that edits can be reverted only to the last published point and that a completed publication cannot be undone through that editing reset, so verify content before overwriting the last reference version. Bandwidth exhaustion blocks publishing new changes until the quota resets or the package is upgraded. Keep an independent copy of critical text/media and check current usage before a time-sensitive launch. This is documentation-based guidance; no live site or publication was executed.
sections.zh: 指南要求在编辑器点击 Publish、确认 Yes，成功后检查线上 URL。每次期望公开修改后都需重新发布。指南提醒编辑只能恢复到最近发布点，完成发布后不能通过编辑重置撤销，因此覆盖最近参考版本前应核对内容。带宽用尽会阻止发布新修改，直到额度重置或升级。应另存关键文字/媒体，并在有时限的发布前查看用量。本段仅基于文档，未操作真实站点或发布。

sections.title_en: Resolve the package and starting-price discrepancy
sections.en: The pricing page lists Free at $0 with 250 MB storage and bandwidth and a subdomain. Its generic Premium card has 3 GB each, a first-year domain, branding removal, domain connection and Store, but no readable numeric price. The FAQ names Basic, Advanced, Professional and Gold, with 3/12/24/36-month commitments; confirm which package the generic card describes. The homepage quotes custom domains from $12.80/month on an annual prepaid plan, whereas the pricing FAQ says $10.80/month on the same stated basis. Do not normalize either as a confirmed quote. Advanced/Professional/Gold are said to include email accounts; additional mailboxes can be purchased. Check actual checkout currency, tax, renewal, store limits and domain eligibility.
sections.zh: 定价页 Free 为 $0，含存储/带宽各 250 MB 和子域名。通用 Premium 卡片为各 3 GB、首年域名、移除品牌、连接域名和商店，但未显示可读金额。FAQ 列出 Basic、Advanced、Professional、Gold 四档，期限为 3/12/24/36 个月，应确认通用卡片具体属于哪档。首页称自定义域名年付预收起价 $12.80/月，定价 FAQ 在同样描述下却为 $10.80/月，不能将任一归一为已确认报价。Advanced/Professional/Gold 称含邮件账户，也可另购邮箱。实际币种、税费、续费、商店上限及域名资格需结账确认。

sections.title_en: Read renewal timing and refund exclusions
sections.title_zh: 读取续费时间与退款排除
sections.en: Terms say auto-renewal charging starts approximately two weeks before the package ends and must be disabled at least two weeks before expiry to avoid it. Initial discounts do not automatically carry to renewal. Separately purchased AI Credit Packages can auto-renew even if the website plan is cancelled or free, and require separate cancellation. The detailed 14-day refund policy applies to a first Free-to-Premium website purchase for at least a three-month term; it excludes renewals, tier upgrades, domains, email/design packages, and AI services/credits. A used complimentary domain’s standalone cost is deducted from an eligible plan refund. Long prepaid periods do not receive proportional refunds on discontinuation. These details qualify the broad pricing-page guarantee.
sections.zh: 条款称自动续费约在套餐结束前两周开始扣款，要避免续费须至少提前两周关闭。首购折扣不自动延续到续费。单独购买的 AI Credit Packages 即使网站取消或免费也可能自动续费，须独立取消。详细 14 天退款政策适用于第一次从 Free 升为 Premium、且至少三个月的网站购买，排除续费、换档升级、域名、邮件/设计包，以及 AI 服务/额度。符合退款条件时，已使用免费域名按单独售价扣除。长期预付停止使用不按比例退款。这些细节限制了定价页概括退款保证。

sections.title_en: Choose SITE123 with its hosting boundary in mind
sections.title_zh: 根据托管边界选择 SITE123
sections.en: The pricing FAQ explicitly refuses website download and identifies SITE123 as a proprietary online service. Its hosting is included; external deployment or self-hosting rights are not established. A small brochure site whose owner accepts the editor’s layouts and vendor hosting may be a good evaluation case. A team needing to move a complete editable website to another host, control arbitrary application source or run an independent backend should resolve those needs before paying for a long term. Keeping content copies is still useful but is not a runnable site export. No account, payment, form, store, quota reset or migration behavior was tested here.
sections.zh: 定价 FAQ 明确不允许下载网站，将 SITE123 定义为专有在线服务；托管包含在内，未确立外部部署或自托管权利。接受编辑器布局及厂商托管的小型展示站可作为评估场景。需要把完整可编辑站点迁往其他主机、控制任意应用源码或运行独立后端的团队，应在长期付款前解决这些需求。保存内容副本有用，但不是可运行网站导出。本次未实测账户、支付、表单、商店、额度重置或迁移行为。
